notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature whose power is 1 or greater.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to the creature's power, ultimately milling the creature.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
